massachusetts.labor_agency_name: Massachusetts Attorney General, Fair Labor Division
massachusetts.ag_name: Massachusetts Attorney General, Consumer Advocacy & Response Division
massachusetts.state_note: The Massachusetts State Retirement Board runs the State Employees' Retirement System, a defined benefit pension under state law for state employees and certain other public workers.

michigan.labor_agency_name: Michigan Department of Labor and Economic Opportunity, Wage and Hour Division
michigan.ag_name: Michigan Department of Attorney General, Consumer Protection Team
michigan.state_note: Michigan's Office of Retirement Services runs the State Employees' Retirement System, a defined benefit pension for state workers hired before March 31, 1997, plus a defined contribution plan for later hires.

minnesota.labor_agency_name: Minnesota Department of Labor and Industry, Labor Standards Division
minnesota.ag_name: Minnesota Attorney General, Consumer Action Division
minnesota.state_note: The Minnesota State Retirement System manages defined benefit pension funds covering state employees, State Patrol, corrections workers, judges, and legislators.

mississippi.ag_name: Mississippi Attorney General, Consumer Protection Division
mississippi.state_note: Mississippi's Public Employees' Retirement System (PERS) is a defined benefit plan providing lifetime pensions to eligible state and local public employees.

missouri.labor_agency_name: Missouri Department of Labor and Industrial Relations, Division of Labor Standards
missouri.ag_name: Missouri Attorney General, Consumer Protection Section
missouri.state_note: Missouri's MOSERS runs a defined benefit pension for state employees that vests after five years of service and pays a lifetime monthly benefit.

montana.labor_agency_name: Montana Department of Labor & Industry, Employment Standards Division
montana.ag_name: Montana Department of Justice, Office of Consumer Protection
montana.state_note: Montana's Public Employee Retirement Administration (MPERA) runs the state's public employee retirement systems, including defined benefit pensions for state and local workers.

nebraska.labor_agency_name: Nebraska Department of Labor, Office of Labor Standards
nebraska.ag_name: Nebraska Attorney General, Consumer Affairs Response Team
nebraska.state_note: Nebraska's Public Employees Retirement Systems (NPERS) administers six mandatory retirement plans for state, county, school, judges, and State Patrol employees.

nevada.labor_agency_name: Nevada Office of the Labor Commissioner
nevada.ag_name: Nevada Attorney General, Bureau of Consumer Protection
nevada.state_note: Nevada's Public Employees' Retirement System (PERS) is a defined benefit plan providing a lifetime base income to qualified state and local public employees.

new hampshire.ag_name: New Hampshire Department of Justice, Consumer Protection and Antitrust Bureau
new hampshire.state_note: The New Hampshire Retirement System (NHRS) is a defined benefit plan paying lifetime pensions to state, county, and municipal employees, teachers, police officers, and firefighters.

new jersey.labor_agency_name: New Jersey Department of Labor & Workforce Development, Division of Wage and Hour Compliance
new jersey.ag_name: New Jersey Division of Consumer Affairs (Office of the Attorney General)
new jersey.state_note: New Jersey's Division of Pensions & Benefits runs the Public Employees' Retirement System (PERS) and Teachers' Pension and Annuity Fund (TPAF) defined benefit pensions.
